_comment: Data-driven per-lexeme flags (lexeme-flag generalization, 2026-11-18). Keyed by LEXEME NAME (unique) -- not by present3rd citation -- because citation keys are NOT lexeme-unique: Gahneha 'hold (flexible)' and Ganeha 'hold (long)' both print SG3 present ᎦᏁᎭ (ganeha), so citation-keyed GLOBAL seeding of surfaceOverrides would leak one lexeme's SG1 rows into the other (the exact pre-scope bug the withVerbScope mechanism fixed). A library consumer supplies request.lexeme = the lexeme name; VerbConjugationFacade opens a per-conjugation VerbRegistry scope and applies this entry's flags -- identical isolation to the test harness. Citations/forms are book-romanization (converted with tsalagiToSyllabaryCed + the ow->owa / hl->lo book-normalization at load time, mirroring VerbBaseSpec.toSyll). Provenance notes keep the project's missing-data-visibility rule. -- tio 18Nov26
